run_test_suite: run the multimodal_gen test suite for a given suite name with optional partitioning and filtering
run_pytest_with_retries: run pytest on a list of test files with automatic retry on transient failures and JUnit XML output
auto_partition_test_cases: partition a list of diffusion test cases across multiple shards using LPT scheduling for balanced runtime
collect_test_items_from_files: collect test node IDs from a list of Python test files using pytest --collect-only
run_component_accuracy_tests: run component accuracy test files with optional multi-GPU distributed execution and filter expressions
